<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/f454e469-38c7-4b4f-af72-a41ee39ca7d6.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/f454e469-38c7-4b4f-af72-a41ee39ca7d6.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="createOrderItemRequest" type="createOrderItemRequest"/>
  <xsd:element name="createOrderItemResponse" type="createOrderItemResponse"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrderItemRequest">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element name="order" type="xsd:string"/>
      <xsd:element name="pricebook_id" type="xsd:string"/>
      <xsd:element name="quantity" type="xsd:int"/>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrderItemResponse">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="createOrderItem" type="createOrderItem_200Type" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='createOrderItemResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='createOrderItem']">
        <xsd:annotation alternateOldName="createOrderItem_200" optional="true" responseCode="200">
          <xsd:documentation>Order item created successfully</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="createOrderItem_200Type">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="message" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>Response message</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
</xsd:schema>
